done_when: The extension correctly detects generation completion and keeps hands-free ON when the tab is in the background.
need: When the browser tab running the DeepSeek chat is unfocused or backgrounded (e.g., while waiting on a 7-minute gate), the AIBridge extension fails to detect the end of the generation and falsely triggers 'AIBridge hands-free is OFF. DSA showed no final answer after the result and the chat never went idle'. Root cause hypothesis: Chrome background tab throttling delays the DOM MutationObserver scrape, so the bridge misses the final idle state, times out, and disables hands-free. This causes massive idle time for DSA (7 hours wasted in MTS-2026-11-01-0852Z).
title: aibridge-false-hands-free-off-on-background-tab-11-01
